title: Ungraded Lab: Turning functions into tools

notes.goal: This lab teaches you how to turn standard Python functions into tools that LLMs can automatically discover, parameterize, and execute via AISuite.

steps.title: Environment Setup
steps.what_happens: Imports necessary libraries like json and loads environment variables to prepare for client initialization.

steps.title: Initialize AISuite Client
steps.what_happens: Creates an AISuite client instance which acts as the unified interface for interacting with different LLM providers.

steps.title: Create First Tool
steps.what_happens: Defines a simple Python function with a clear docstring to fetch the current time, letting AISuite automatically convert it into an LLM tool.

steps.title: Manual Tool Schema
steps.what_happens: Demonstrates how tool schemas are structured behind the scenes with name, description, and parameters, and shows how to manually handle tool execution loops.

steps.title: Add Advanced Tools
steps.what_happens: Defines multiple practical tools including a weather fetcher using IP lookups, a file writer, and a styled QR code generator.

steps.title: Multi-Tool Orchestration
steps.what_happens: Asks the LLM a complex prompt requiring multiple tools in sequence, showing how the model correctly determines order of execution and parameters.

notes.results: The code ran successfully without any errors. All tool calls were handled correctly by the LLM, returning precise weather data, writing reminder files, and generating custom QR codes with embedded images.
try_next: Write a new custom math or calculator function, add a docstring, and pass it as a tool to the LLM.
Modify the QR code tool to accept custom colors or change the error correction level.
Create a multi-step prompt that chains together the weather tool and file writer to log daily forecasts automatically.
